literal: Those who drink even if they seem like, character those-without friendship, than growing decreasing is sweet.
translation: Even if they show an affection so intense that they seem to drink you up, it is better for friendship with people of no character to shrink rather than grow.
modern: அன்பால் உங்களை குடிப்பவர்கள் போல நடித்தாலும், நல்ல பண்பு இல்லாதவர்களின் நட்பு வளர்வதை விட குறைவதே நல்லது.
explanation: This couplet warns against the deceptive affection of people lacking good character. The word 'parukuvār' evokes the image of someone looking at you with such intense, consuming love that they could drink you up. However, if such people have no true moral character, their friendship is dangerous. Therefore, it is much better and safer for such a friendship to dwindle away rather than to grow stronger.
